title: Network Interruption Handling
description: Handle network interruptions gracefully with retry logic, backoff, and offline detection in React Query.

data.text: Mobile users experience network drops, flaky connections, and captive portals. React Query provides built-in retry logic, but production apps need more nuanced handling: exponential backoff, offline queuing, and graceful UI states.

items: retry: Number of retry attempts. Default: 3.
retryDelay: Delay between retries. Can be a function for exponential backoff.
retryOnMount: Retry failed queries when component mounts.
data.title: Retry Options
Exponential backoff retry

data.text: Use the browser `navigator.onLine` API and React Query context to adjust behavior when offline. You can disable refetching, show cached data, or queue mutations for later.
Show an offline banner when `navigator.onLine` is false. Allow users to continue reading cached data while preventing writes that would fail.

points: Detect offline state and adjust UX accordingly.

data.takeaway: Robust network handling makes your app feel reliable even on poor connections.
